fact: The Mauritius Revenue Authority says foreign suppliers of digital services can register for VAT and submit VAT returns online through its VAT filing portal.
The Mauritius Revenue Authority says VAT due from foreign digital-service suppliers must be remitted electronically to it, in several approved foreign currencies.
The Mauritius Revenue Authority says all VAT returns from foreign digital-service suppliers must be submitted electronically through its systems.
The Mauritius Revenue Authority says individuals file their 2025 income tax returns electronically with a User Id (NID, NCID or TAN) and password, due 15 October 2025.

The MRA's 2022/23 integrated annual report lists e-filing among its services, with an income-returns e-filing season run for taxpayers from August to October 2022, and a Taxpayer Portal giving individuals 24/7 online services.
The MRA's 2022/23 integrated annual report says it collected 98% of tax receipts through e-payment.
The MRA's 2022/23 integrated annual report says it reached e-filing of tax returns in almost all cases.
